summary: Descriptive-metadata correction for the five homeowner legal chargebacks posted by Approve Treatment (Canyon Gate invoice 283101 x4, Waterview PS-INV350881 x1): the owner-facing description becomes category + catalogue service phrase + "(Attorney Inv. <ref>)", raw_row_jsonb gains the item/allocation links and the reference, tenure_id is stamped with the owner the review approved (verified to be the posted and still-current owner). No upload batch label, amount, date, category, GL, posting or allocation changes; no rows added or removed.

preflight.name: exactly five owner charges came from Approve Treatment
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE raw_row_jsonb->>'source' = 'legal_invoice_review'

preflight.name: the five rows still carry their reviewed description and amount
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM homeowner_transactions h JOIN (VALUES ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, 100800, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 3200, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 3200, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, 6800, 'Legal Fees - Collections / 283101'), ('5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid, 55735, 'Legal Fees - DRV Enforcement / PS-INV350881')) v(id, amt, d) ON v.id = h.id AND v.amt = h.amount_cents AND v.d = h.description

preflight.name: the five total 169735 cents
preflight.sql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount_cents), 0)::bigint FROM homeowner_transactions WHERE id IN ('14286fec-5e96-4644-8f40-8c625403ae0b'::uuid, '513cfe4b-0538-499f-bdf1-6b4e69ad8ee2'::uuid, 'e4c92b73-f31c-422a-9804-35edba863dbc'::uuid, 'e9195994-6fb8-41c5-b6d6-97f15e413516'::uuid, '5fce468b-9bc0-4109-8cf8-158ae5be7733'::uuid)

expected_changes: homeowner_transactions: 5 rows updated (description, raw_row_jsonb keys added, tenure_id stamped). Amounts, dates, categories, running balances untouched.

tenure_id is filled only with the tenure the review approved and the posting used, which must still be the current owner; any mismatch leaves the row untouched and the verify step rolls the whole migration back.
No inserts or deletes. No upload batch, journal entry, legal posting, allocation, review, invoice item or ownership tenure changes.
